title: After the Rain
note: Start quietly. Build into the last chorus, then let the final chord ring.

lines.lyric: Streetlights settle on the road
A silver line beside our home
We count the windows one by one
And wait for morning to come

instructions.Pianist: Set the mood with spacious broken chords. Give a clear breath before Verse 1.
instructions.Percussionist: Soft kick on 1 and 3, rim on 2 and 4. Keep the eighth notes relaxed.
